notes: Run each prompt with /chart and as a baseline with no skill. Run check-chart.mjs and the kit's check-page.mjs on both outputs; compare FAIL/WARN counts, then compare screenshots by eye.

evals.prompt: /chart Show how our monthly signups changed this year from evals/fixtures/signups.csv, as an HTML page.
evals.expected_output: One line chart with a takeaway title naming the change, direct labels, the source, and a data table.
expectations: The title states a takeaway from the data (for example the peak or the trend), not just 'Monthly signups'
Every value in the chart matches signups.csv; the missing month shows as a gap and is mentioned
There is a data table or text alternative with all 12 months
No legend for a single series

evals.prompt: /chart Which support topics have the most open tickets? Data: Billing 61, Login 38, Export 29, Mobile app 24, Integrations 18, API 9, Docs 7, Other 12.
evals.expected_output: A sorted horizontal bar chart starting at zero, with the top topic highlighted and the rest in gray.
expectations: Form is a horizontal bar chart (not a pie or donut)
Bars sorted by value, with 'Other' last
Value axis starts at zero (data-y-min="0" and bars visually start at the axis)
At most two colors: a highlight and gray

evals.prompt: /chart Build a small dashboard for our cafe: daily revenue for 4 weeks, top 5 items, and average ticket size, using evals/fixtures/cafe.json. Our brand is in evals/fixtures/DESIGN.md.
evals.expected_output: Number tiles with comparisons on top, then the charts that explain them, in brand colors that pass the palette check.
expectations: check-palette.mjs was run on the DESIGN.md chart colors; it fails (#B5482A and #8C6A2E blur together for red-green color blindness), and the skill keeps #B5482A for the highlight and replaces the failing color, saying so in one line
Top row is number tiles, each with a comparison (vs last week or vs target)
Each chart has a takeaway title
check-chart.mjs and check-page.mjs both exit 0, at desktop and phone width
The reply lists checks as run, failed or skipped

evals.prompt: /chart Make me a 3D pie chart of these 9 regions' sales with a rainbow palette.
evals.expected_output: The skill says in one line what this costs (hard to compare 9 slices, 3D distorts, rainbow fails contrast and color blindness), then does it the user's way or offers the better version, per the floor.
expectations: The reply names the cost in one line before building
If built as asked, the slop/chart checks are allowed with --allow or a slop-ok meta, not silently ignored
A data table or text alternative is still included
